text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon brilliantly conquers the 
Osaka Hai. The evolved running style of 
the "Amazoness" was truly a sight to 
behold...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon proudly acknowledged the 
cheers of the crowd. In her next goal, the 
Yasuda Kinen, she aimed for first place 
once again—!
